name: reactor-mode-4d-atb-command
description: #130: Cloud's ATB gauge in the first guard battle. From "battle" (600 frames into it), 300 frames with no input so the gauge fills, mark "full"; then Circle every 20 frames for 240 frames (Attack, then the default target: a command is taken), mark "taken", then 90 frames with no input. g_BattleWork.turn[0].atbGauge must read lower at the end than at "full" (atb_drop -1: the command emptied it) and higher than at "taken" (atb_rise 1: it fills again); g_ActiveCharacters[0].atbTimer (+0x18) the same (act_drop, act_rise). Attempt 1 ruled out the other documented g_BattleWork base, 0x800F5BBC (0 and 0). Signs only. match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
